No additional implementation defect was confirmed in this pass. The remaining untested edge cases are lower-impact API semantics or require fault models outside the authorized scope.

The audit remains at 25 confirmed findings. The strongest evidence covers:

- snapshot-state corruption under deterministic and randomized crash scenarios,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive partial suffix replacement,
- LFU clone corruption and LRU bincode deserialization failure,
- retry duplication after `AppendError::Timeout`,
- reconfiguration, trimming, subscriber lifecycle, and configuration-validation defects.

All retained reproduction sources, commands, and outputs are documented in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
